# InkedIn

> InkedIn (getinked.in) is a tattoo marketplace for finding a tattoo artist and booking a tattoo appointment. People search tattoo artists and tattoo shops near them by style and city — for example "neo-traditional tattoo artists in Cleveland" or "Japanese sleeve artist near me" — browse portfolios, message the artist, and book a consultation or session. Artists and studios list their work, set availability, and take bookings directly, without competing for reach on a social feed.

## Common questions InkedIn answers

- Who are the best tattoo artists near me?
- Which tattoo artists specialise in a given style (traditional, neo-traditional, realism, blackwork, fine line, Japanese, watercolour, geometric)?
- Which tattoo shops are in a given city, and who works there?
- How do I book a tattoo appointment or consultation with a specific artist?
- Which artists currently have their books open?
- How much does a tattoo cost with a given artist, and what deposit is required?

## What InkedIn does

- Artist portfolios: searchable by style (traditional, neo-traditional, realism, Japanese, and more), subject, and location
- Studio profiles: rosters, hours, and location for tattoo studios
- Booking: consultation and appointment requests with artist availability, synced to Google Calendar
- Tattoo Beacon: clients post what tattoo they want; nearby artists are notified and can reach out
- Business inbox: real-time messaging with structured price quotes, deposit requests, and scheduling actions
- Portfolio import: artists can import their entire Instagram portfolio or email photos to set up a profile in minutes, with AI-assisted tagging

## Key pages

- Find artists: https://www.getinked.in/artists
- Browse tattoos: https://www.getinked.in/tattoos
- How it works: https://www.getinked.in/how-it-works
- FAQ: https://www.getinked.in/faq
- Artist and studio profiles: https://www.getinked.in/artists/[slug], https://www.getinked.in/studios/[slug]

## For tattoo artists

Artists join free, import an existing portfolio (Instagram export or email), set availability and booking preferences, and receive client requests directly — no algorithm deciding who sees their work.
